## MicrosoftWordClient interface

The Microsoft Word client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `microsoftWordContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [MicrosoftWordResources](./microsoft-word_contract.microsoftwordresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface MicrosoftWordClient extends ClientBrand<MicrosoftWordResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[MicrosoftWordResources](./microsoft-word_contract.microsoftwordresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
